atoms.b: The first ever supermarket in the UK was built in London in ((1448 ++1948)).
It was called the ((++London Chocolate)) Co-operative Society.

feedback.end: You may have heard of a shop called the Co-op. Well, this was the very first Co-op ever built!

instruction.text: What can you find in a supermarket? Label the image correctly.
Supermarkets also provided a new range of processed foods in the 60s and 70s. Listen and select the matching processed food items.

feedback.finish: Due to the shortage of building materials after World War 2, many of the first supermarkets in Britain were set up in existing buildings, such as old cinemas.

atoms.a: The invention of supermarkets meant that people could shop for everything in one place.
Everyone had to carry all their shopping home from the supermarket.

hint.text: In the 1960s and 70s, many more people had cars.

atoms.a: More people now had fridges and freezers, which meant that they could go to the shops less often.
